name: @exaudeus/memory-mcp

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Session start for a project. Returns your preferences (global), gotchas, and recent work for this project and branch. Also surfaces stale entries that need review. Call once at the beginning of a conversation. Lobe names: default. Example: brief(lobe: "default")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search stored knowledge by relevance within a project. BEFORE starting a task, describe what you are about to do in natural language and get relevant knowledge back (semantic + keyword search). Example: recall(lobe: "default", context: "how does auth token refresh work") or recall(lobe: "default", context: "refactoring the payment webhook handler")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

context.description: Describe what you are about to do, in natural language.

tools.name: gotchas
tools.description: Pitfalls in a project, optionally scoped to an area. Check BEFORE making changes to avoid known traps. Example: gotchas(lobe: "default", area: "auth") or gotchas(lobe: "default") for all gotchas.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: conventions
tools.description: Coding patterns and standards in a project, optionally scoped to an area. Check BEFORE writing new code to follow established patterns. Example: conventions(lobe: "default", area: "testing") or conventions(lobe: "default") for all conventions.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

tools.name: gotcha
tools.description: Flag a pitfall you hit — what you expected vs what actually happened. Gets priority in brief and recall results. Returns related knowledge you might want to review. Example: gotcha(lobe: "default", observation: "Gradle cache must be cleaned after Tuist changes or builds silently use stale artifacts")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The gotcha. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: convention
tools.description: Record a codebase pattern you observed — how the code is structured, naming rules, architectural decisions. For personal rules or preferences, use prefer() instead. Returns related knowledge. Example: convention(lobe: "default", observation: "All ViewModels use StateFlow for UI state. LiveData is banned.")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The convention. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Store architecture, dependencies, decisions, progress, or any knowledge not covered by gotcha() or convention(). Use this as the catch-all for insights worth remembering. Returns related knowledge. Example: learn(lobe: "default", observation: "Payments module depends on auth for tokens only — no other cross-module dependency")

lobe.description: Memory lobe name (defaults to "default" if omitted)

observation.description: The observation. Write naturally — first sentence becomes the title.

durabilityDecision.description: Use "store-anyway" only when re-storing after a review-required response.

tools.name: prefer
tools.description: When your user corrects you or states a working-style rule, record it here. Persists globally by default and is surfaced in every brief(). Optionally scope to a specific project. Example: prefer(rule: "Never use !! operator") or prefer(rule: "Use Anvil for DI", lobe: "default")

rule.description: The preference or rule. Write naturally.

lobe.description: Optional. Scope this preference to a specific lobe. Omit for global. Available: default

tools.name: fix
tools.description: Correct or delete a memory entry. IDs appear in brief(), recall(), gotchas(), and conventions() results. Pass correction to update content; omit correction to delete the entry entirely. Example: fix(id: "gotcha-a1b2c3d4", correction: "Fixed in v2.3 — cache is auto-cleaned now") or fix(id: "gotcha-a1b2c3d4") to delete.

id.description: Entry ID (e.g. gotcha-3f7a, conv-5c9b, gen-a2d1, pref-8e4f).

correction.description: New text to replace the entry content. Omit entirely to delete the entry.

lobe.description: Optional. Searches all lobes if omitted. Available: default

tools.name: memory_bootstrap
tools.description: First-time setup: scan repo structure, README, and build system to seed initial knowledge. Run once per new codebase. If the lobe does not exist yet, provide "root" to auto-add it to memory-config.json and proceed without a manual restart.

lobe.description: Memory lobe name. If the lobe doesn't exist yet, also pass "root" to auto-create it. Available lobes: default

root.description: Absolute path to the repo root. Required only when the lobe does not exist yet — the server will add it to memory-config.json automatically.

budgetMB.description: Storage budget in MB for the new lobe (default: 2). Only used when auto-creating a lobe via "root".
